provenance_note: This manifest records SHA-256 digests for the canonical checked-in golden fixtures so future slices can verify byte equality before acceptance. The digests are recomputed from the current fixture bytes by the PS-035b smoke and compared against the values recorded here. The fixture files themselves are NOT mutated by PS-035b.
truth_boundary: ProofStudio proves what the pipeline did. The golden-fixture freeze proves byte equality to recorded digests only. It is not tamper-proof, not Object Lock, not legal authenticity, and not production immutability. The cost cap is a local policy gate, not a real billing API integration and not production multi-user budget accounting. PS-035b makes no claim of B2 Object Lock, tamper-proof storage, real billing API integration, or production multi-user budget accounting.
